# Copilot Instructions — GmailProjectForGitHubActions

## Project Overview
- Java 8 (JDK 1.8) Maven project for automated interview schedule management
- Selenium WebDriver for web scraping (headless Chrome)
- Twilio REST API for voice call reminders
- Static HTML schedule page deployed to cloud.codifixsolutions.com
- Run command: `java -cp "target/classes;target/dependency/*" GmailProjectForGitHubActions.<ClassName>`

## Current Status
- JTwine scraping: **disabled** (commented out)
- VProp scraping: **active**
- Twilio call reminders: **active** (Selenium-based, cron-driven)
- Schedule page: **active**

## Java Code Style
- Java 8 compatible — no `var`, no complex lambda streams
- Static methods for utility classes
- `LinkedHashMap` for insertion-ordered maps
- Explicit `TimeZone` on all date operations (IST = `Asia/Kolkata`)
- Log format: `[yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss] message`
- XML-escape Twilio TwiML content; URL-encode HTTP POST parameters

## HTML/CSS/JS Code Style
- Inline styles and scripts (single-file HTML generated by Java StringBuilder)
- CSS class naming: lowercase with hyphens (e.g., `card-dd`, `section-vprop`)
- JS: vanilla ES5-compatible — no arrow functions, no `let`/`const` in generated HTML
- Event handlers via `onclick` attributes
- Mobile-first responsive design

## Security Rules
- SHA-256 hashed credentials for login (no plaintext)
- Session expiry: 1 hour; use `sessionStorage`
- Twilio: Basic auth with Account SID + Auth Token
- Always HTML-escape user input (`escapeHtml()`), XML-escape TwiML (`escapeXml()`)
- URL-encode all HTTP POST parameters
- Use `HttpURLConnection` timeouts (connect + read)
- Prefer environment variables for secrets

## Key Architecture
- `TwilioInterviewReminder.java` — Selenium scrapes schedule page, Twilio calls assignees before interviews
- `JTwineScheduleForTodayFromGitHubActions.java` — Generates `deploy/index.html` via StringBuilder
- `deploy/index.html` — Login-gated schedule page with dropdowns and live updates
- `deploy/discussionCount/` — Discussion stats page
- File-based dedup via `twilio-called.txt` (auto-clears on new day)
- PHP API at `cloud.codifixsolutions.com/dropdown-api.php` for dropdown state
